messages:
sre-lead: Announcement: maintenance window for connection pool migration in eu-central on 2026-04-25 08:00 UTC. Goal: move clients to updated proxy with improved connection reuse. Expected impact: brief connection resets and 502/503 spikes for <90s during switch-over. Full window 45m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/conn-pool-migrate.
marco: ack. I'll throttle non-critical CI jobs and pause long-running exports at 07:45 UTC.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: @oncall scheduled for this maintenance (policy: conn-migrate). Reminder 15m before.
elaine: CS: I'll prep a short customer advisory for Dedicated tenants and post in support channels.
infra-bot: Note: dependent peering refresh scheduled 08:05 UTC in the region. Recommend we move that to +30m to avoid overlap. Reply `hold-peer` to delay.
sre-lead: good catch infra-bot. Please hold the peering refresh to 08:35 UTC.
support-lead: We'll standby for tickets; suggested canned reply ready. If any enterprise customers show live traffic we'll escalate to oncall.
marco: health checks I'll watch: `promql: sum(rate(http_request_errors[1m])) by (service)`, connection counts from proxies, and tcp resets. Abort if error-rate > 2% for 3m.
oncall-bot: Channel created: #incidents/conn-migrate-1777609000. Alerts will stream there.
sre-lead: Thanks. Post a quick ack once you've paused jobs. I'll drop a checklist 20m before. /end
